summary: Re-tested requested backend/frontend regressions on external preview URL. All targeted flows passed: dashboard no longer stuck, /api/vehicles returns 200 with integer year fields, admin self-approval works without developer_code and logs admin override audit, accountant self-approval is blocked, and /print?type=invoice renders required UX-A4 elements with single barcode and without legacy signatures/QR.

integration_issues.issue: Multiple 401 console resource errors appear before authentication; this did not block login or tested flows.

action_items: Optional: investigate pre-login 401 console noise to reduce runtime log clutter.

Action runtime admin override policy is functioning as implemented: admin self-approval succeeds and emits APPROVAL_GRANTED_ADMIN_OVERRIDE while non-admin proposer remains blocked by four-eyes.
DocumentPrint DOM matches requested cleanup: single final total block, no rendered legacy signature/QR sections, and one rendered document-single-barcode.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 pytest + API checks in UI run)

context_for_next_testing_agent: If re-running UI automation, wait explicitly for dashboard-search-input after login to avoid false stuck-loading assumptions. For seal logic, this run confirmed the minimum requirement (no fake dynamic seal without approval) on /print?type=invoice.
rca of the issue: Previously reported dashboard freeze linked to /api/vehicles year=null mismatch was not reproducible in this run. Reproduction checks show endpoint stability (200 + list) and integer year typing across returned rows, indicating the normalization fix is effective under current preview data.
